description: Tool adapters. Each entry: detect (the --detect command), install_hint (what to run if missing), invoke (usage). Adapters are thin wrappers around a CLI the user installs SEPARATELY — zero license entanglement.

screenshot.install_hint: npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium   (or: brew install playwright && playwright install chromium)
screenshot.engine: playwright (browser) + python3 (ephemeral static server for local files)

video.install_hint: brew install ffmpeg   (or: apt-get install ffmpeg)

transcribe.install_hint: pipx install openai-whisper   (or: pip install -U openai-whisper) — also needs ffmpeg

email.engine: react-email (render only — sending is outward-facing, confirm first)

notes.install_hint: none — zero-dependency markdown. Optionally set THANOS_NOTES_VAULT to an Obsidian vault / memos dir.

graph.install_hint: none — uses python3 (+ git if present)
